engine: r1864's /architecture + /comfort feature carousel — a row of vertical PANELS where the CENTRE panel is in FOCUS (scale 1 + brightness 1, its caption lit) and the side panels are DIMMED peek-insets (scale sideScale + brightness sideDim, caption hidden), with EDGE-PEEK of the neighbouring panels; round ‹ › arrows (+ a 'N / TOTAL' counter) rotate WHICH panel is centred (the rail re-centres on the active panel). Each panel = a full-height image + a caption at its bottom-left. On enter the panels stagger up. The 'the building's qualities, one at a time, in focus' chapter. Harvested from D_r1864 (r18641 /comfort: ЛИФТЫ / ОСТЕКЛЕНИЕ / ИНЖЕНЕРНЫЕ СИСТЕМЫ / БЕЗОПАСНОСТЬ / СЕРВИС / ПАРКИНГ, ‹ N/5 ›).

measured_teardown.move: TWO motions. A) ENTER (scroll-into-view scrub, p 0..1, PURE set(p)): panels stagger fade + translateY 40->0 over 0..1 (each offset ~0.08); then layout() applies the focus geometry. B) ROTATE (‹ › arrows / drag / dots / click a side panel): change the centred index; layout() animates the rail translateX so the active panel sits CENTRED in the viewport, scales the active panel to 1 + brightness 1 + caption opacity 1, and the others to sideScale + brightness sideDim + caption 0; the 'N / TOTAL' counter updates; wraps (loop) or clamps. ease power3.out.
measured_teardown.cited: r18641 /comfort: a row of vertical panels (ЛИФТЫ / ОСТЕКЛЕНИЕ / ИНЖЕНЕРНЫЕ СИСТЕМЫ / БЕЗОПАСНОСТЬ / СЕРВИСНОЕ ОБСЛУЖИВАНИЕ / ПАРКИНГ), each with a serif caption at its bottom-left, the centre panel emphasised + edge-peek of the next, a round ‹ 'N / 5' › counter bottom-right.

start.what: ScrollTrigger start for the enter stagger.

loop.what: wrap at the ends (true) or clamp (false).

once.what: play the enter once or reset on leave-back.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when a shared page Lenis drives scroll.

entry: CenterFocusCarousel.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), next(), prev(), go(i), refresh(), destroy }. target = .cfc-stage > .cfc-viewport ( .cfc-rail > .cfc-panel( .cfc-panel-img + .cfc-panel-cap ) x N ) + .cfc-nav( .cfc-prev + .cfc-counter + .cfc-next ). set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the ENTER stagger; next/prev/go rotate the centred panel.
law: transform (translate, scale) + opacity + filter(brightness) only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL. reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown (rail scrolls native overflow-x, panels equal). owns_pin false (a scroll-into-view carousel). F-08 DRAG LAW: pointer move/up/cancel on WINDOW, settle always on end (rotate only if past max(50px, 18% panel-step)). GSAP+ScrollTrigger required for the scroll reveal; set(p) + next/prev standalone. Clicking a side panel centres it.
gate_mode: scroll-into-view carousel. Verify: on enter the panels stagger up; the CENTRE panel is in focus (scale 1 + brightness 1 + caption lit) while the sides are dimmed insets (scale sideScale + brightness sideDim + caption hidden), with edge-peek; ‹ › (and drag / panel-click) rotate which panel is centred (the rail re-centres), counter N/TOTAL updates, wraps. Smoothness via the scroll path. NOTE: the rail is one band — scroll so it's centred to screenshot the focus + insets + peek.
proven: lab: 6 feature panels ('КОМФОРТ И СЕРВИС': Лифты / Остекление / Инженерные системы / Безопасность / Сервисное обслуживание / Паркинг). ENTER (inline opacity, p / p0 / p2 / p5): 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 -> 0.5 / 1 / 0.97 / 0.49 -> 1 / 1 / 1 / 1. FOCUS@0: active panel scale(1) + brightness(1) + cap 1; side panel scale(0.9) + brightness(0.45) + cap 0; counter 01/06. AFTER next: old-active dims (brightness 0.45, cap 0), new-active lights (brightness 1, cap 1), counter 02/06; WRAP prev 02->01, prev again -> 06/06 (loop). Drag + panel-click rotate. Zero console errors. Smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle, scroll-enter + 2 rotates): 373 frames, 0.54% long frames -> PASS. Photos = quadro renders (honest demo assets; engine takes any photos). Relatives: fullscreen-media-carousel (ONE full-bleed slide, no focus/peek), center-seam-split (a seam-opener), poi-caption-carousel (a flat rail, no centre-focus) — this is the 3-up CENTRE-FOCUS panel carousel. Serif = Playfair Display (Didot/Bodoni class).
